entities.summary: Ophelia Pastrana Ardila is a Colombian-Mexican transgender speaker, YouTuber, technologist and comedian. She is the first transgender woman naturalized by Mexico. Business Insider listed her as one of the most influential women on Twitter regarding technology aspects. In 2018 she was recognized as one of the BBC's 100 Women.
